title: Sabacos
summary: Ethiopian king who in Herodotus ruled Egypt for fifty years (2.137–139); Shabaka of the Kushite line.
description: Added from the Herodotus import (The Histories, tr. Rawlinson). Herodotus gives reign lengths and synchronisms, not BC years, and no tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year (Herodotus is display-only and gives none).

reign.date: “the Ethiopian was lord of the land for fifty years”
reign.citation: Herodotus, Histories 2.137 (tr. George Rawlinson; Roman Roads Media etext, 2013), p. 155 (PDF p. 157)
reign.note: Sabacos the Ethiopian displaces the blind Anysis; foretold as fifty years (2.139). Generations (provisional) dates the Kushite conquest of Egypt about 778 BC under a different king; Herodotus gives no year.
